blocks.text: Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector virtual devices contain a Zscaler Service Account called zsroot. This account is a privileged user that enables secure administrative access and management of the virtual device. In order to safeguard your organization, Zscaler strongly recommends implementing routine password rotation as a best practice.

Zscaler Cloud Connectors are typically accessed with the SSH key that your cloud provider provides when you create the connector. Although your zsroot password is not required for logging in, Zscaler recommends periodically changing the password.

blocks.item: Log in to the VM as user zsroot.
Follow the prompts to enter the current password and then a new password.
Log in to the device through the console/management interface as user zsroot.
Follow the prompts to enter the current password and then a new password.
